---
name: Stutter / slowdown
about: A hitch, frame drop or slow area. Attach the zip REPORT.bat makes.
title: "Stutter: <where in the game>"
labels: performance
---

**Attach the zip from `REPORT.bat` here** (drag it into this box). It has the recording with your
F8 marks, a summary, your PC's specs and the end of the log.

**Where were you?** (area / boss / what you were doing, e.g. "Boletarian Palace, crossing the
bridge after the first gate, turning the camera")

**What did you see at each F8 press?** (one short line per mark if you remember: a freeze, a skip,
a drop that lasted a few seconds ...)

**Frame-rate setting:** (PLAY.bat auto / 30 / 50 / 60 / unlimited / custom number)

**Anything else** (other programs running, laptop on battery, G-Sync/FreeSync on ...)
